column1: # Abyss loot (#5, AD-2): what a Triglavian cache, node or subnode of an abyssal
# room leaves in its wreck. Header in docs/content/schema.md. Authored, every
# rate [A]: no type id, only a type group and a word of the type's name. Restart
# tier: the played tier 0-6 (abyss::play_tier), or `*`. A row whose tier is `off`
#   turns the whole table off (the world switch).
# cache: the word in the cache type's name (case-insensitive): bioadaptive,
# group: a type group id (protocol numbers; never a type id).
# name_has: `*`, a word the type's name must contain (case-insensitive), or a
#   token: {tier} is the key word of the played tier (Calm, Fierce, ...: read
#   from the bundle's abyssal keys), {grade} is the mutaplasmid grade of the
# chance_ppm: one independent draw per matching row, in parts per million; a hit
#   picks one published type that matches, uniformly.
# qty_min, qty_max: quantity uniform in the range (a copy's quantity is its runs).
# copy: 1 gives one blueprint copy whose runs are the quantity, 0 a plain stack.
